issues.issue: Is the new evidence admissible under subsection 110(4) of IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: The documents arose later or were not reasonably available; Facebook posts were withheld out of fear, which he says explains the omission.
issues.result_quote: I consider that the appellant has not shown that he could not reasonably have submitted this document to the RPD prior to the rejection of his claim.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in finding the SSIS had no interest in him because of imputed political opinion?
issues.applicant_position: RPD contradicted itself on SSIS interest and misunderstood the political affiliation question; SSIS imputes opinion from beard and mosque attendance.
issues.result_quote: the appellant has not demonstrated that the SSIS had an interest in him and that this interest continues to this day

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in drawing a negative inference of lack of subjective fear?
issues.applicant_position: Not claiming asylum in the US and the delay were explained by hope for change in Egypt and his brother's advice.
issues.result_quote: the RPD correctly concluded that the appellant demonstrated through this conduct a lack of subjective fear in his country.
